meta.title: Muscles of the human body
meta.nomenclature: English forms of Terminologia Anatomica (TA98/TA2) names; common alternatives in 'aka'.
conventions: One entry per named muscle; heads, bellies and parts are listed in 'parts', not as separate entries.
'paired' is true for muscles present on both the left and right sides (skeletal muscles only).
'variable' is true for muscles not present in everyone.
'count' is the number of serial muscles per side (e.g. 11 external intercostals); omitted when 1.
Individual-muscle totals double paired entries and multiply by 'count'; serial groups without a fixed count are counted once per side, so totals are approximate.
sources: Cross-checked against Wikidata TA98/TA2-coded terms and Wikipedia's List of skeletal muscles of the human body

muscles.name: Levator palpebrae superioris
muscles.note: Raises the upper eyelid; its smooth-muscle slip is the superior tarsal muscle.

muscles.name: Stapedius
muscles.note: The smallest skeletal muscle in the body.

muscles.name: Orbicularis oculi
parts: Deep palpebral (lacrimal) part, or Horner's muscle

muscles.name: Depressor supercilii
muscles.note: Often described as part of orbicularis oculi.

muscles.name: Levator labii superioris alaeque nasi
muscles.note: The longest muscle name in the body.

muscles.name: Risorius
muscles.note: Absent in some people.

muscles.name: Transversus menti
muscles.note: Inconstant slip crossing the midline under the chin.

muscles.name: Pyramidal muscle of auricle
muscles.note: Inconstant slip of tragicus.

muscles.name: Pterygoideus proprius
muscles.note: Inconstant slip between the infratemporal crest and lateral pterygoid plate.

muscles.name: Chondroglossus
muscles.note: Often counted as part of hyoglossus.

muscles.name: Triticeoglossus
muscles.note: Inconstant slip from the triticeal cartilage to the tongue.

muscles.name: Palatoglossus
muscles.note: Also a soft-palate muscle; the only tongue muscle not supplied by the hypoglossal nerve.

muscles.name: Palatopharyngeus
muscles.note: Also acts as a longitudinal muscle of the pharynx.

muscles.name: Platysma
muscles.note: A facial-expression muscle (facial nerve) spread over the front of the neck.

muscles.name: Cricothyroid
muscles.note: The only intrinsic laryngeal muscle supplied by the superior (external) laryngeal nerve.

muscles.name: Posterior cricoarytenoid
muscles.note: The only muscle that opens (abducts) the vocal folds.

muscles.name: Transversus nuchae
muscles.note: Inconstant thin band over the upper trapezius, supplied by the facial nerve.

muscles.name: Spinalis cervicis
muscles.note: Often poorly developed or absent.

muscles.name: Spinalis capitis
muscles.note: Usually blended with semispinalis capitis.

muscles.name: Interspinales thoracis
muscles.note: Present only at the upper and lower ends of the thoracic spine.

muscles.name: Sternalis
muscles.note: Present in only a small minority of people.

muscles.name: Subcostales
muscles.note: Number varies; best developed low on the back of the chest wall.

muscles.name: Rectus abdominis
muscles.note: Tendinous intersections divide it into the "six-pack" segments.

muscles.name: Cremaster
muscles.note: Surrounds the spermatic cord and testis; in females a few fibers follow the round ligament.

muscles.name: Pubovaginalis / Puboprostaticus
muscles.note: Pubovaginalis in females; puboprostaticus (levator prostatae) in males.

muscles.name: Deep transverse perineal
muscles.note: Well developed in males; in females largely replaced by smooth muscle.

muscles.name: Compressor urethrae
muscles.note: Female.

muscles.name: Sphincter urethrovaginalis
muscles.note: Female.

muscles.name: Supraspinatus
muscles.note: Rotator cuff.

muscles.name: Infraspinatus
muscles.note: Rotator cuff.

muscles.name: Teres minor
muscles.note: Rotator cuff.

muscles.name: Subscapularis
muscles.note: Rotator cuff.

muscles.name: Palmaris longus
muscles.note: Absent in some people, often on one side only.

muscles.name: Pollical palmar interosseus
muscles.note: Debated; often regarded as the deep head of flexor pollicis brevis.

muscles.name: Psoas minor
muscles.note: Absent in a large share of people.

muscles.name: Gluteus maximus
muscles.note: The largest single muscle in the body.

muscles.name: Obturator externus
muscles.note: Grouped with the adductors by its nerve supply (obturator nerve).

muscles.name: Sartorius
muscles.note: The longest muscle in the body.

muscles.name: Rectus femoris
muscles.note: Quadriceps femoris.

muscles.name: Vastus lateralis
muscles.note: Quadriceps femoris.

muscles.name: Vastus intermedius
muscles.note: Quadriceps femoris.

muscles.name: Vastus medialis
muscles.note: Quadriceps femoris; its lowest fibers are called vastus medialis obliquus (VMO).

muscles.name: Adductor minimus
muscles.note: The upper portion of adductor magnus, sometimes separate.

muscles.name: Gastrocnemius
muscles.note: With soleus, forms triceps surae (the calf).

muscles.name: Soleus
muscles.note: With gastrocnemius, forms triceps surae (the calf).

muscles.name: Opponens digiti minimi (foot)
muscles.note: Often fused with flexor digiti minimi brevis.

muscles.name: Levator claviculae
muscles.group: Well-documented extra muscles (not in Terminologia Anatomica)
muscles.note: Neck; from the upper cervical vertebrae to the clavicle.

muscles.name: Axillary arch muscle
muscles.group: Well-documented extra muscles (not in Terminologia Anatomica)
muscles.note: Armpit; a slip from latissimus dorsi crossing the axilla.

muscles.name: Chondroepitrochlearis
muscles.group: Well-documented extra muscles (not in Terminologia Anatomica)
muscles.note: Chest to arm; a slip from pectoralis major toward the medial epicondyle.

muscles.name: Anconeus epitrochlearis
muscles.group: Well-documented extra muscles (not in Terminologia Anatomica)
muscles.note: Elbow; bridges the cubital tunnel over the ulnar nerve.

muscles.name: Gantzer's muscle
muscles.group: Well-documented extra muscles (not in Terminologia Anatomica)
aka: Accessory head of flexor pollicis longus
muscles.note: Forearm; one of the most common forearm variants.

muscles.name: Extensor digitorum brevis manus
muscles.group: Well-documented extra muscles (not in Terminologia Anatomica)
muscles.note: Back of the hand; can be mistaken for a ganglion cyst.

muscles.name: Fibularis quartus
muscles.group: Well-documented extra muscles (not in Terminologia Anatomica)
muscles.note: Outer ankle.

muscles.name: Accessory soleus
muscles.group: Well-documented extra muscles (not in Terminologia Anatomica)
muscles.note: Calf; can be mistaken for a soft-tissue mass.

muscles.name: Superior tarsal
muscles.note: Smooth-muscle slip of levator palpebrae superioris.

muscles.name: Orbitalis
muscles.note: Bridges the inferior orbital fissure.

muscles.name: Arrector pili
muscles.note: One tiny muscle per hair follicle; millions in total.

muscles.name: Dartos
muscles.note: Scrotal skin; similar smooth muscle lies in the labia majora.

muscles.name: Bronchoesophageus
muscles.note: Smooth-muscle band joining the esophagus to the left main bronchus.

muscles.name: Pleuroesophageus
muscles.note: Smooth-muscle band joining the esophagus to the left mediastinal pleura.

muscles.name: Rectourethralis
muscles.note: Male.

muscles.name: Myocardium
muscles.note: The heart wall itself.
